projects.title: Multi-Market Payment Integration Platform
projects.summary: Centralized payment platform integrating multiple PSP providers with dynamic activation based on geographic markets, including a frontend interface for payment management and monitoring.
description: Integrated multiple PSP providers: Lyra, Worldpay, Crédit Agricole, Linxo, Dlocal, Sogenactif, PayPal
Implemented market-based activation logic for LATAM, Europe, and Canada
Handled payment security, error management, retries, and transaction monitoring
Designed extensible backend architecture for easy onboarding of new payment providers
Developed a JavaScript-based frontend interface to manage payment providers, markets, and configurations
Built dashboards to monitor transactions, PSP status, and error logs
Integrated frontend with secure REST APIs for real-time payment data visualization

projects.title: Cartographic & Mapping Systems
projects.summary: Development of cartographic tools for event spaces and cruise ships, enabling visual navigation, reservations, and itinerary generation.
description: Developed a PHP-based backend tool to generate SVG maps for event floor plans
Visualized stand locations and generated navigation paths to exhibitors
Built Symfony 6 APIs for cruise ship deck plans and cabin availability
Enabled real-time reservation and visualization of available locations

projects.title: Legacy System Migration & Modernization
projects.summary: Migration and modernization of legacy backend systems to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability.
description: Migrated backend from CakePHP 1.4 to CakePHP 4.3
Refactored old PHP native codebases into Symfony-based architectures
Introduced console commands for batch processing and automation
Improved code quality, performance, and long-term maintainability

projects.title: Frontend Platforms & Interactive Dashboards
projects.summary: Development of modern frontend interfaces for ERP, CRM, and booking platforms.
description: Developed React-based dashboards and business applications
Built responsive and user-friendly interfaces for internal and client-facing tools
Integrated frontend applications with REST APIs
Collaborated closely with UX designers and backend teams
